verdicts.reason: Both are nearly the same skyscraper restack, with the headline, then the CTA, then the product, then the footer. In both, the full-width Shop Sale button sits only about 10px from the canvas edges and almost touches the lilac circle. A also wraps the subhead badly, leaving 'case.' alone on its own line, and it bunches content up top while leaving a dead gap of about 80px between the can and the footer. B's 'Every / mixed case.' wrap reads better and its vertical rhythm is more even. However, the gap above B's CTA is a bit large, and its can sits close to the footer.
